name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A horizontal application menubar with File, Edit, View, and Help top-level triggers whose popups (rendered through portals) contain plain items, nested submenus, and separators, with the Help root disabled.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no React state and no open props; each Menu.Root manages its own open state internally and item clicks are only logged via a shared handleClick
nonTrivialInteractions: The Menubar coordinates four contained Menu.Root triggers in a row; keyboard navigation between the triggers and their open menus is the component's menubar behavior (the demo just composes them)

The File menu nests an Export SubmenuRoot (PDF/PNG/SVG) and the View menu nests a Layout SubmenuRoot (Single Page/Two Pages/Continuous); each submenu renders through its own Portal > Positioner > Popup chain with a CaretRightIcon on the SubmenuTrigger
Submenu Positioners use sideOffset={-4} and alignOffset={-4} to tuck the submenu popup flush against the parent popup's edge, while top-level Positioners use sideOffset={4}
SubmenuTrigger styling keys off data-popup-open (in addition to data-highlighted) so the trigger stays visually marked while its submenu is open
The fourth Menu.Root passes disabled so the Help trigger is rendered disabled with no Portal/Popup at all
Every Menu.Item shares one handleClick that logs the item's textContent on click
